Source§

impl CompositeGlyph

Source

pub fn new(component: Component, bbox: impl Into<Bbox>) -> Self

Create a new composite glyph, with the provided component.

The ‘bbox’ argument is the bounding box of the glyph after the transform has been applied.

Additional components can be added with add_component

Source

pub fn add_component(&mut self, component: Component, bbox: impl Into<Bbox>)

Add a new component to this glyph

The ‘bbox’ argument is the bounding box of the glyph after the transform has been applied.

Source

pub fn try_from_iter( source: impl IntoIterator<Item = (Component, Bbox)>, ) -> Result<Self, NoComponents>

Construct a CompositeGlyph from an iterator of Component and Bboxes.

This returns an error if the iterator is empty; a CompositeGlyph must always contain at least one component.

Source
